package main

import (
	"context"

	inboundmcp "example.com/agentfixture/internal/adapters/inbound/mcp"
	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/adapters/outbound/postgres"
	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/application/usecases"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	pool, err := postgres.NewReadOnlyPool(ctx, "dsn")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	_ = pool.Ping(ctx)
	_ = inboundmcp.NewServer(usecases.NewReader(postgres.NewRobots(pool)))
}
